messages:
Anika: Hey — small onboarding benefits/ payroll check. I enrolled in medical last week but not sure when dental actually starts. Also: FSA contributions — is there a hard deadline during onboarding or can I add later?
Anika: Bonus Q: I got a relocation reimbursement approved by recruiting, what docs do I send and where?
Anika: And my direct deposit didn’t hit today — first payday delay?
people-ops-bot: Welcome to Redwood, Anika! :wave: Quick links: onboarding checklist https://redwood.example/onboard-check, benefits portal https://benefits.redwood.example (use corporate SSO).
Maya (People Ops): Hi Anika — congrats and great questions. Short answers: dental/vision are effective the 1st of the month after your enrollment is processed. If you enrolled within 30 days of your hire date coverage typically starts the 1st of the following month.
Maya (People Ops): FSA: elections must be made during your initial enrollment window (30 days from hire) to be pre-tax for the plan year. After that you can only change during open enrollment or with a qualifying life event.
Maya (People Ops): Relocation reimbursements — route to Finance. Use the relocation expense form + receipts. Submit via Expensify and tag policy "Relocation-Redwood" or email expenses@redwood.com with subject: "Relocation Expense - Anika - [hireID]".
Maya (People Ops): Payroll: first direct deposit can take one payroll cycle to appear if you set it up after the payroll cutoff. Payroll runs biweekly (every other Friday). If you don’t see it by next payday, ping @Jamal.
Ethan: I ran into the same dental timing when I joined — it kicked in the following month after my enrollment was confirmed.
Jamal (Finance): FYI on relocation: when submitting Expensify, include the recruiting approval email and put the project code RELO-01 in the notes so we code it correctly. Attach receipts as PDFs. We usually process reimbursements within 7–10 business days after approval.
Jamal (Finance): For payroll: confirm your bank routing + acct are entered in Workday > Pay > Direct deposit. If they are and it still didn’t hit after next payroll, I’ll look it up.
Maya (People Ops): Links you’ll need: relocation form: https://intranet.redwood.example/forms/relocation.pdf, FSA guide: https://benefits.redwood.example/fsa-guide, expedited help slot: https://calendly.com/people-ops/benefits-15m (book if you want us to walk through).
Anika: Awesome — thanks Maya and Jamal. I’ll submit the relocation form + receipts to Expensify today and double-check direct deposit in Workday.
Maya (People Ops): Perfect — tag this thread when you submit and I’ll confirm coverage dates once benefits team processes your enrollment. :thumbsup:
Anika: Will do. Thanks everyone!
